name: Circle to bold line
what: A dark screen with a thin glowing word that grows from a dot. A big soft circle of that dark colour shrinks away and washes out over a speckled light page, the word turns dark and fades, and a bold line rises in letter by letter, from blurred and faint to sharp.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f80 the thin word grows from a dot; f28-f43 the big circle sweeps in (its edge reaches the frame about f33, fast in the middle, settling at the end); f43-f50 the word turns dark and the circle washes out; f81-f90 the word fades; f86-f123 the bold line rises letter by letter (about 2.8 f apart), each from blurred and faint, 150 px low, to sharp; then a 25 f hold

tracks.name: word grows
tracks.what: the thin word grows from a dot to full size, glowing on the dark screen

tracks.name: circle shrinks
tracks.what: the big soft circle shrinks from beyond the frame to a little under 1.5 frame widths
tracks.easing: power2.inOut (the circle edge sweeps in fast, then settles)

tracks.name: page switch
tracks.what: the circle washes out to a faint blur, the word goes from light to dark, the glow fades, speckles show on the page

tracks.name: letters up
tracks.what: each letter rises 150 px from blurred and faint to sharp, one every 2.8 f

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: the bold line stands still (the film grain moves)
